mapper.sql: s.statement_id, s.statement_no, s.visit_id, s.patient_id, s.reversal_of_id, s.issue_date, s.treatment_fee, s.material_fee, s.discount, s.total_due, s.paid_amount, s.payment_method, s.payment_time, s.status, s.claim_no, p.full_name AS patient_name, c.clinic_name, c.clinic_code
FROM statement s JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = s.patient_id LEFT JOIN visit v ON v.visit_id = s.visit_id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = v.clinic_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE s.visit_id = #{visitId} ORDER BY s.statement_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statement (statement_no, visit_id, patient_id, reversal_of_id, issue_date, treatment_fee, material_fee, discount, total_due, paid_amount, status) VALUES (#{statementNo}, #{visitId}, #{patientId}, #{reversalOfId}, #{issueDate}, #{treatmentFee}, #{materialFee}, #{discount}, #{totalDue}, #{paidAmount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(statement_no, 4) AS INTEGER)), 0) FROM statement WHERE statement_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.update: UPDATE statement SET status = #{status} WHERE statement_id = #{statementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (statement_id, amount, method, gateway_txn_no, status, paid_at, fail_reason) VALUES (#{statementId}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{gatewayTxnNo}, #{status}, #{paidAt}, #{failReason})
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, statement_id, amount, method, gateway_txn_no, status, paid_at, fail_reason FROM payment WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} ORDER BY payment_id
